ModMetaData.name: Archinity - Glitterites
ModMetaData.author: cjd72
ModMetaData.description:
Part of the Archinity suite.
Adds the Glitterites: an Ultra-tech permanent enemy, seeded by the archons as a threshold. They hold orbit, they field mixed forces of overclocked soldiers and mechanoids, and they will not be negotiated with.
Their settlements generate in orbit only. Their planetside presence comes from Ushanka's Glittertech Expansion, whose glitterheart outpost and facility quests are rebound to this faction - so every glitterheart you take is taken off them.
Those quests are also re-gated for a long multi-era playthrough: vanilla ships them at day 45 with 1000 threat points, which is far too early for a run that begins in the neolithic.
Mechanoid deployment uses vanilla mechs as a guaranteed backbone, with Alpha Mechs layered on where present.
Requires Odyssey (orbit layer) and Biotech. Glittertech Expansion and Alpha Mechs are optional - without them the faction simply fields a smaller roster and gains no planetside sites.
